headline: US strikes Iran IRGC, Iran fires missiles, Israel captures Hamas security chief
subheadline: US strikes hit IRGC sites in Iran, killing at least two at a wedding in Sirich, while Iran launched missiles toward regional targets.
lede: U.S. military forces struck Iranian IRGC targets in retaliation for attacks on commercial shipping and American personnel, while Iranian state media reported explosions at U.S. air bases in Jordan. An American airstrike on a wedding ceremony in Sirich killed at least two people and wounded several others, and explosions were also reported in southern Iran near the Strait of Hormuz. Iran responded by launching ballistic missiles from multiple provinces—including Yazd, Kermanshah, Zanjan, Arak, and Kurdistan—toward regional targets. In Gaza, Israeli special forces captured senior Hamas internal security chief Muein al‑Arabid during a joint Shin Bet‑IDF raid, accompanied by airstrikes on surrounding military sites.

sections.title: Ukrainian strikes hit Russian drone sites
sections.body: Russian drones struck the Orlivka border crossing on Ukraine’s frontier with Romania, according to the State Border Guard Service. Ukrainian special forces targeted drone storage and preparation sites in Donetsk and Crimea, as well as communication and command posts. Air raid alerts were issued across Kyiv and surrounding regions as Shahed‑type UAVs attacked multiple cities, while President Putin reported nearly a thousand drones attempted to hit Moscow and St. Petersburg, targeting three oil refineries. Ukrainian ombudsman Lubinets disclosed that only 2 % of mobilized men actually reach the front lines, and EU defense ministers have not yet approved Patriot missile assistance.

sections.title: US‑Iran strikes and Israeli Hamas capture
sections.body: U.S. forces conducted strikes against IRGC targets in Iran following attacks on commercial shipping in the Persian Gulf and against American personnel in the region. Iranian state media IRIB reported explosions at U.S. air bases in Jordan, while local sources confirmed at least two deaths and several wounded in an American airstrike on a wedding ceremony in Sirich. Iran launched ballistic missiles from multiple provinces—including Yazd, Kermanshah, Zanjan, Arak, and Kurdistan—toward regional targets, and explosions were also reported in southern Iran near the Strait of Hormuz. Israeli special forces captured senior Hamas internal security chief Muein al‑Arabid in Gaza City during a joint Shin Bet‑IDF operation, accompanied by IDF airstrikes on surrounding military targets.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: The rapid escalation from U.S. strikes on IRGC sites to Iranian multi‑province missile launches signals a deepening direct confrontation between Washington and Tehran, heightened by retaliatory threats and airspace closures. Simultaneously, Israel’s capture of a senior Hamas security chief adds a new flashpoint in Gaza, while cross‑border activity reported by Hezbollah‑affiliated channels suggests broader regional entanglement.
